description: Creates or changes one flag of this branch's environment; apps read the change within a minute with no redeploy. Reversible: set it back the same way. Scope: projects:write.

key.description: Flag key: a letter, then lowercase letters, digits and underscores

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project used last in this session, or the only one.

value.description: Optional text value the app reads

name: flags.set
title: Set a flag
